children: Lovesac reported second-quarter fiscal 2027 results with total net sales of $161.2 million and gross profit of $110.3 million for the quarter ended August 2, 2026. The company recorded net income of $7.4 million, or $0.51 per diluted share, and reported adjusted EBITDA of $(1.3) million for the quarter. Management noted receipt of approximately $21.0 million in IEEPA tariff refunds that materially improved reported margins and cash position.
Revenue (Total net sales): $161.2 million for the thirteen weeks ended August 2, 2026 (up 0.4% year-over-year).
Gross profit: $110.3 million for the quarter; gross margin 68.4% (benefited from $21.0 million IEEPA tariff refunds recognized primarily in cost of merchandise sold).
Operating income: $10.9 million for the quarter (operating margin 6.9% of net sales).
Net income: $7.4 million for the quarter; diluted EPS $0.51 (net income per diluted share includes $0.86 benefit from tariff refunds).
Adjusted EBITDA (non-GAAP): $(1.3) million for the thirteen weeks ended August 2, 2026.
Channel performance: Showroom sales totaled $114.1 million for the quarter (up 4.6% year-over-year), while Internet sales were $40.2 million (down 5.3% year-over-year); other sales declined 23.2%.
Retail footprint: Company ended the period with 284 showrooms, a net increase of 14 showrooms year-over-year (opened 5 and closed 2 in the quarter).

Product momentum and innovation: Company emphasized its busiest year of new product introductions, with management indicating launches on track for the second half of fiscal 2027 to support future growth.

Supply chain and tariffs: Received $21.0 million in IEEPA tariff refunds (recognized largely as cost of merchandise sold), and management continues to monitor tariff outlook without speculating on further changes.
Liquidity and balance sheet: Cash and cash equivalents increased to $68.8 million as of August 2, 2026; no outstanding balance on the line of credit and $34.0 million available under it.
